## Context
Three follow-ups on the unit-tier subprocess-isolation guard, all raised as non-blocking advisories by the LLM code review on Gerrit 2506 and deferred there.

`tests/_subprocess_isolation.py` protects the unit suite from subprocesses that escape the per-test sandbox. The current `_check_home_escape` rule can over-flag any argv expression that merely references a name or attribute called `home`, `mkdtemp`, or `TemporaryDirectory`, even when the value is an unrelated local or an already-harnessed `tmp_path` value. False positives are costly because they redden innocent files and encourage reverting the guard.

Two guard contracts are also under-tested: the collection-time violation must raise `pytest.UsageError` (not `pytest.fail`, which appears as an xdist INTERNALERROR), and hazards found in module-level helper functions must honor the file-level/module `pytestmark` opt-out fallback when no individual test name is available.

## Outcome
Narrow home-escape detection to concrete escape forms that actually leave the harness, while preserving true positives for `Path.home()` and `os.environ["HOME"]`. Add behavioral regression tests for the narrowed negative/positive cases, the `UsageError` contract, and module-level-helper file-level opt-out behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `_check_home_escape` reports real home escapes such as `Path.home()` and `os.environ["HOME"]` but does not report unrelated locals named `home`, `mkdtemp`, or `TemporaryDirectory`, nor harnessed `tmp_path`-rooted mkdtemp usage.
- [x] A behavioral unit test asserts collection-time isolation violations raise `pytest.UsageError` instead of source-grepping for the error text.
- [x] A behavioral unit test proves a module-level helper hazard is covered by a file-level/module `pytestmark` opt-out fallback when the finding has no specific test name.

## Testing
- RED: run targeted tests in `tests/unit/test_collection_isolation_guard.py` and confirm the new contracts fail on unmodified `origin/main`.
- GREEN: rerun the targeted guard tests after the implementation change.
- Verification: run `make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2` with inherited `GIT_CONFIG_*` variables unset before pushing.
